description_en: Queries the log of a specific task instance that monitors data quality
description_zh: 查询指定数据质量监控任务实例的日志内容
name: GetDataQualityScanRunLog

parameters.help_en: The ID of the data quality monitor run record
parameters.help_zh: 数据质量监控运行记录ID
parameters.name: id

parameters.help_en: The starting position of the log, in bytes, relative to the beginning of the file. Each query returns a maximum of 512 KB of content
parameters.help_zh: 日志起始位置，相对于文件起始位置的偏移量，单位byte，每次查询至多返回512kb内容
parameters.name: offset
